title: Gather Baseline System Information
objective: Collect comprehensive details about the host's operating system, installed packages, and network services to define the scope of the assessment.
rationale: Understanding the current state (OS version, kernel, installed software) is critical before running any vulnerability scanner to ensure accurate results and scope definition.
expected_output: A structured inventory report detailing OS version, kernel version, installed packages (with versions), and running services.
success_criteria: OS distribution and version are identified.
A list of all installed packages and their versions is generated.
All open network ports and associated services are documented.
